sentences.text: Rudi memesan iga sapi segar dari jagal langganan di pasar.
sentences.en: Rudi orders fresh beef ribs from his regular butcher at the market.
sentences.ko: 루디는 시장 단골 정육점 주인에게 신선한 소갈비를 주문해요.

sentences.text: Rina menemukan pisau besar yang dulu dipakai seorang jagal di pasar daging.
sentences.en: Rina found a large knife once used by a butcher at the meat market.
sentences.ko: 리나는 예전에 고기 시장 도축업자가 쓰던 큰 칼을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Rudi mengundang teman-teman alumni sekolah kuliner untuk mencicipi menu baru.
sentences.en: Rudi invited his culinary school alumni friends to taste the new menu.
sentences.ko: 루디는 요리 학교 동창들을 초대해 새 메뉴를 맛보게 했어요.

sentences.text: Rina menjual buku kenangan alumni sebuah sekolah yang sudah lama tutup.
sentences.en: Rina sells an alumni yearbook from a school that closed long ago.
sentences.ko: 리나는 오래전에 문을 닫은 학교의 졸업 앨범을 팔아요.

sentences.text: Setelah penggabungan dua cabang, Rudi memimpin dapur yang jauh lebih besar.
sentences.en: After the merger of two branches, Rudi runs a much bigger kitchen.
sentences.ko: 두 지점이 합쳐진 뒤 루디는 훨씬 큰 주방을 이끌어요.

sentences.text: Setelah penggabungan dua pasar loak, lapak Rina pindah ke lapangan yang lebih luas.
sentences.en: After the two flea markets merged, Rina's stall moved to a bigger field.
sentences.ko: 벼룩시장 두 곳이 합쳐진 뒤 리나의 노점은 더 넓은 공터로 옮겼어요.
